# CLI reference

The `legacy-audit` command (`legacy_audit/cli.py`, built with Typer; entry point `legacy_audit.cli:app` in `pyproject.toml`, also `python -m legacy_audit`). Each command is a thin wrapper: it loads the config, calls the function named below and prints the result. The GUI calls the same functions.

## `legacy-audit diff`

Compare two runs: counts and added / removed / changed records per entity.

Function: `legacy_audit.cli.diff`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RUN_A` | argument |  | Run id, 'previous', 'latest' or folder |
| `RUN_B` | argument | `latest` | Run id, 'previous', 'latest' or folder |
| `--config`, `-c` | option | `audit.yaml` | Path to audit.yaml |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | option |  |  |
| `--json` | option |  | Write the full diff as JSON here |
| `--show` | option | `10` | Records listed per entity |

## `legacy-audit doctor`

Check Python, Node, pptxgenjs, Mermaid CLI, Dependency-Check, OSV-Scanner, JDK and Git.

Function: `legacy_audit.cli.doctor`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config`, `-c` | option |  | audit.yaml (tool paths, output folder) |

## `legacy-audit enrich`

Write the AI enrichment with any model (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Azure, Ollama).

Copilot in VS Code stays the default (/audit-enrich); this runs the same stages from the
command line with the model set in audit.yaml (ai:) or LEGACY_AUDIT_AI_* variables. The
API key is read from an environment variable, never from the config.

Function: `legacy_audit.cli.enrich`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--stage`, `-s` | option |  | Only these stages (repeatable) |
| `--stale` | flag | `False` | Only the stages that are missing or stale |
| `--provider` | option |  | copilot, openai, anthropic, azure-openai or ollama (else ai.provider) |
| `--model` | option |  | Model name (else ai.model) |
| `--base-url` | option |  | Endpoint URL |
| `--check` | flag | `False` | Only test the model settings with a tiny request |
| `--run` | option | `latest` | Run id, 'latest' or 'previous' |
| `--config`, `-c` | option | `audit.yaml` | Path to audit.yaml |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | option |  |  |

## `legacy-audit facts`

Print facts of one kind as JSON (read-only; for the Copilot agent and for people).

Function: `legacy_audit.cli.facts`

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KIND` | argument |  | services, screens, sql_statements, ... |
| `--filter`, `-f` | option |  | field=value (repeatable); field=~text for contains |
| `--fields` | option |  | Comma-separated fields to show |
| `--limit` | option | `50` | At most this many rows (max 500) |
| `--run` | option | `latest` | Run id, 'latest' or 'previous' |
| `--config`, `-c` | option | `audit.yaml` | Path to audit.yaml |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | option |  |  |
